name: gaps2-ac-targets
description: Action-card targets decided from state (audit-gaps-2, gate TI4_RULES_AC / rulesGateActionCards; were honour system). pbd60@122 (Mentak's tactical action at 308, Muaat holds Andeara there). Parley ('After another player commits units to land on a planet you control: Return the committed units to the space area') on Muaat's home planet (not in the active system): refused. Salvage ('After you win a space combat: Your opponent gives you all of their commodities') targeting Ghost (not in that combat): refused. Reparations ('After another player gains control of a planet you control: Exhaust 1 planet that player controls') targeting Crimson (not the active player): refused. Direct Hit ('After another player's ship uses SUSTAIN DAMAGE ...: Destroy that ship') with no damaged Muaat ship at 308: refused. Intercept ('After your opponent declares a retreat during a space combat: Your opponent cannot retreat during this round'): Mentak plays it; Muaat's retreat from 308 is refused.
